summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a 6-K reporting a share purchase agreement to acquire 19% of Jurong Day Night Clinic from Ms. Ting Shih King. Consideration is US$256,500, paid via 186,410 restricted shares in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, with a nine-month lock-up. No board seat or voting control; Seller retains 81% and full operating control. Closing subject to due diligence, regulatory approvals, and Nasdaq notice. A two-year contingent repurchase allows Seller to unwind if performance targets or software integration fail within nine months. Watch: closing conditions and integration milestones.
